results.name: Leonardo constructs the quill with his pencil
results.detail: INSCRIBE by leonardo: 15 pencil strokes, pencil on the wall in 13 of 19 samples; the result is an instrument (“quill”), dormant until awakened

results.name: The quill becomes an independently animated instrument
results.detail: awakened at 0:15.1; the quill issues 18 events of its own (0 denied); it writes while Leonardo’s pencil rests in 38 of 38 samples; lifecycle constructed → activated → commanded → executing → completed

results.name: Leonardo gives the quill a semantic instruction
results.detail: COMMAND leonardo → quill-1: to DHH, intent “Tell him what we’re making. Ask if he’ll help us make more of it.”, 3 facts, constraints [beautiful, honest, one page, legible calligraphy], output in paper-1, approval required. Without a recipient it is denied: incomplete command (missing recipient)

results.name: The exact sponsorship letter appears in readable calligraphy
results.detail: 9 written lines; joined, they equal the commanded text character for character (line breaks aside). Every character has a glyph, every stroke is inside the page, x-height 12.0 px in a 1280×720 close-up

results.name: Quill movement stays aligned with the forming letters
results.detail: 331 writing samples, max nib-to-ink gap 2.1e-12 px; quill tip never jumps (max 8.15 px per 1/240 s, at 0:47.5)

results.name: The text survives independently of the rendering
results.detail: exported 144 KB of JSON without drawing a frame: exact text, 231 vector strokes, recipient, purpose, authorizing character, 5 history entries tied to scene-log events

results.name: The quill writes another recipient without behavior changes
results.detail: the same 19-event sequence as a rewrite to DHH; the envelope now reads “Ada”

results.name: A finished letter can be reviewed, revised and saved
results.detail: reviewed by leonardo at 1:11.6; a revision is written as v2 on a fresh sheet in 20 events, v1 kept; the saved draft carries both versions

results.name: The animation replays deterministically
results.detail: 34 events; reseeding gives an identical log; schedule-order and time-order replays match, 0 capability mismatches; frame hash 627379246/627379246

results.name: Nothing is sent without separate, explicit authorization
results.detail: no DISPATCH in the log; the letter is DRAFTED and prepared, external delivery: not sent. A DISPATCH by Leonardo or by the quill is denied (external delivery needs separate, explicit human authorization, and nothing in the scene can grant it). The radio signal is logged as an observation with reply:false; a signal claiming to be a reply is denied (nothing was sent, so no signal can be a reply).

results.name: Runs 75 to 90 seconds
results.detail: 88 s including the end card; the letter is written from 0:31.0 to 1:03.7
